claim: A map of measured or predicted nutrient status is not by itself a fertilizer-rate recommendation map; prescriptions require crop- and region-specific calibration, analytical method compatibility, yield-response evidence and agronomic rules.
conditions: Applies when converting continuous nutrient predictions into low-medium-high classes or fertilizer decisions for sugarcane.
limitations: Thresholds can change with crop, soil, region, extractant, unit, economic objective and management system.
recommended_action: Publish concentration/status maps first; add recommendation classes only after a documented local agronomic guideline and expert review are linked to each target.
not_allowed_action: Do not infer a universal fertilizer rate directly from model predictions or a generic global threshold table.
